title: Question do people have positive experiences or negative experiences?
content: So, I have been noticing a lot of posts lately of people say negative things about Mallworld and that it's manipulative or evil by some being or something. I try not to think about those, in part because what I call my "Mallworld" dreams are extremely positive. They are in many ways are very enlightening, I visit with a godlike being regularly in a temple beyond space and even though I'm intimidated I still feel calm. As far as I know she's just a figment of my dream. So I don't understand how sure some people are about the mallworld and I don't find it to be a negative. So I'm genuinely curious on other people's take. Do you have a positive or negative experience? In general?
